headline: Rakuten Viki’s K-Drama Day Returns For The Fourth Year: Celebrate With Free Shows, Special Prizes, Talent Exclusives, And More
summary: Rakuten Viki has launched its fourth annual K-Drama Day, running from September 25 through October 1 with free shows, prizes, and exclusive content.

headline: xikers Reveals Comeback Date With Teaser For “ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING”
summary: K-pop group xikers announced their upcoming eighth mini-album, "ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING," with a new teaser.

headline: Watch: CRAVITY Announces Comeback With Teaser For New EP “sonorous”
summary: K-pop group CRAVITY announced their upcoming comeback by releasing a teaser video for their new mini album, "sonorous," set for September 30.

headline: Watch: ENHYPEN Takes 7th Win And Triple Crown For “Bloody Paradise” On “M Countdown”; Performances By EVAN, &TEAM, And More
summary: ENHYPEN secured their seventh music show trophy and first triple crown for “Bloody Paradise” on the September 10 episode of “M Countdown.”

headline: Jung Min Ah And Dong Ha’s Lives Collide Over Fashion And A Hidden Family Secret In “Mission: Mompossible”
summary: A new poster for the daily drama “Mission: Mompossible” highlights the entangled lives of two mothers and their children.

headline: Todd Haynes, Frances McDormand, Zhang Ziyi Join Lumière Festival Lineup
summary: Filmmakers Todd Haynes, Robert Eggers, and Zhang Ziyi, alongside Oscar winner Frances McDormand and the Coen brothers, have joined the Lumière Film Festival lineup.
